A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain 11 readable pages. Neither includes the cited appendices, limiting comparison of that material. All supplied pages were compared: text and rendered content match except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp. The judgments below concern the supplied content.

before.justification: v3 reports original C3R experiments, including benchmark and missing-modality results in Tables 1–2, representation analyses in Figure 3, and ablations in Figure 4.

after.justification: v4 retains the same original experimental results in Tables 1–2 and Figures 3–4.

M1.justification: Sections 3–5 retain the same attention-based instrumental variable, twin-network counterfactual construction, C3 risk, and regularization objective in Equation 10.

E1.justification: The same coverage is reported: NYU Depth V2, SUN RGB-D, FOOD101, MVSA, BraTS, and synthetic MMLSynData, with unchanged corruption and missing-modality scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 1–2 and Figure 3. For example, Table 2 retains HMIS, HVED, RSeg, mmFm, LCKD, and LCKD+C3R.

E3.justification: Section 6 and the table captions retain the same settings, including 50% sample corruption, noise levels, average/worst-case accuracy reporting, and 15 BraTS modality combinations.

E4.justification: The supplied corruption tests, missing-modality evaluations, representation-correlation analysis, and regularization-term ablations are identical. Additional analyses referenced in Appendix H are unavailable in both PDFs.

E5.justification: Both versions state that experiments use five runs and retain identical boxplots in Figure 3. No repeated-run, seed, or uncertainty-reporting information changes in the supplied content.

E6.justification: All supplied numerical entries and plotted findings match. For example, Table 1 reports QMF+C3R NYU Depth V2 average accuracies of 77.58 at noise level 0 and 59.72 at noise level 10 in both versions.

T1.justification: Definition 3.1, Theorems 3.2–3.5 and 4.1, their stated assumptions, and Equations 1–10 are unchanged. Appendix A proofs are not included in either supplied PDF and cannot be compared.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about causal completeness, relaxing exogeneity and monotonicity assumptions, theoretical support, and plug-and-play C3R.

C2.justification: The supplied mechanism explanations and interpretations are identical, including stronger correlation with sufficient-and-necessary causes, weaker spurious correlation, and reduced gaps between modalities. No qualifications or limitations are revised.

D1.justification: Section 6.1 retains identical MLP dimensions, Adam settings, regularization weights, and NVIDIA RTX A6000 hardware information. The referenced implementation appendices are absent from both files.

R1.justification: Section 7, citations, and the complete supplied reference lists are identical. The positioning relative to modality consistency, modality specificity, and prior causal-sufficiency work is unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv v3 dated 24 Jan 2025 to v4 dated 23 Apr 2025. The title, authors, prose, terminology, and section organization are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–4, Tables 1–2, equations, captions, and page layout are unchanged. Rendered pages match exactly outside the version/date stamp.

improvement.justification: The supplied PDFs have identical scientific text, results, references, and visual presentation. Updating the arXiv stamp provides no substantive quality gain or loss. Both also omit the referenced appendices, leaving that completeness limitation unchanged; their unavailable contents cannot be assessed.
